name: Harvest Bakery Service Inc
old_description: Suppling all major brands of equipment to the baking industry!
about:
Harvest Equipment and Fabrication Inc began in 1999 when Tim Kemp and Jeff Giesel founded the company in Burnsville, Minnesota. The business started as a provider of bakery equipment service, sales, parts, and consultation for the Midwestern market.

Today the company supplies new and used bakery machinery from major brands, covering categories such as mixers, ovens, dividers, sheeters, slicers, and packaging equipment. It also operates a fabrication shop that retrofits and modernizes older equipment, and offers consulting services including plant planning, installation coordination, process design, and employee training. The facility in Lakeville, Minnesota, sits 15 minutes from the MSP airport and serves as a showroom where customers can view and test equipment.

Harvest serves retail and industrial bakeries, food manufacturers, and commercial processing operations across the Midwest and globally. Its technicians have performed installations and repairs worldwide, and the company brokers used equipment for clients ranging from single machines to complete production lines.

The founders recognized that increasing lead times and labor shortages create demand for custom solutions, so Harvest focuses on retrofitting existing machinery and integrating automation to extend equipment life and improve throughput.
